gates.raw:
- name: Run the CI report smoke and gate (issue #103)
        # Dogfood the closed report surface on every OS: validate over a
        # fixture with all four report formats, the blocked readiness
        # gate, and the drift side-channel guarantee. The report bytes
        # are uploaded with the job artifacts (below). The report
        # directory is exported through the step env (never a plain
        # shell variable) so the Node assertions always see it, and the
        # upload names explicit finalized files guarded on existence.
        timeout-minutes: 5
        env:
          REPORTS: ${{ runner.temp }}/lekalo-ci-reports
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p "$REPORTS"
          rm -rf target/ci-report-smoke
          cp -r tests/fixtures/loader/valid-direct-visibility target/ci-report-smoke
          cd target/ci-report-smoke
          BIN=../../target/debug/lekalo
          "$BIN" --version > /dev/null
          # validate: the passing run + the four projections.
          "$BIN" --json validate --report-file "$REPORTS/validate.json" --project . > /dev/null
          "$BIN" --json validate --report-file "$REPORTS/validate.sarif" --report-format sarif --project . > /dev/null
          "$BIN" --json validate --report-file "$REPORTS/validate.junit.xml" --report-format junit --project . > /dev/null
          "$BIN" --json validate --report-file "$REPORTS/validate.md" --report-format md --project . > /dev/null
          node -e "const r=require(process.env.REPORTS + '/validate.json'); if (r.schema_version !== 'lekalo/ci-report/v0.6.3') process.exit(1); if (r.evaluation.verdict !== 'ready') process.exit(1);"
          # readiness --check: the blocked release gate is a nonzero exit
          # with the typed unavailable envelope, and its report still lands.
          set +e
          "$BIN" --json readiness --phase release --check --report-file "$REPORTS/readiness.json" --project . > "$REPORTS/readiness-envelope.txt" 2>&1
          code=$?
          set -e
          test "$code" -ne 0 || { echo 'blocked readiness --check must not exit 0'; exit 1; }
          node -e "const r=require(process.env.REPORTS + '/readiness.json'); if (r.evaluation.verdict !== 'blocked' || r.evaluation.exitCode === 0) process.exit(1);"
          # The canonical report identity and the exact digest spelling.
          node -e "const r=require(process.env.REPORTS + '/validate.json'); const c=require('crypto'); const h=c.createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify(r)+'\\n').digest('hex'); if (!/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(h)) process.exit(1);"
          cd ../..
          echo "REPORTS_DIR=$REPORTS" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
gates.name: Run the CI report smoke and gate (issue #103)

gates.raw:
- name: Upload the CI report artifacts (issue #103)
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: lekalo-ci-reports-${{ matrix.os }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          # Explicit finalized filenames from the confined report
          # directory: never a broad glob over the runner root, and a
          # missing destination fails the upload instead of widening.
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/lekalo-ci-reports/validate.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/lekalo-ci-reports/validate.sarif
            ${{ runner.temp }}/lekalo-ci-reports/validate.junit.xml
            ${{ runner.temp }}/lekalo-ci-reports/validate.md
            ${{ runner.temp }}/lekalo-ci-reports/readiness.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/lekalo-ci-reports/readiness-envelope.txt
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7
gates.name: Upload the CI report artifacts (issue #103)

setup.raw:
- uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
        with:
          # The release/native lane has its own cache and runs in parallel.
          # This job keeps the debug workspace and ordinary gate suites.
          shared-key: build-test

- uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: 24.x
          package-manager-cache: false

- name: Provision PHP 8.3 (issue #54, visible setup step, no project install)
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: '8.3'
          # Composer is needed on every OS by the issue #56 fixture
          # provisioning step (the locked vendor tree is not committed).
          tools: composer
          # The locked Laravel runtime of the issue #56 fixture needs its
          # platform extensions; every dependency-free suite is unaffected.
          extensions: mbstring, openssl, pdo_sqlite, sqlite3, tokenizer, xml, dom, xmlwriter, ctype, fileinfo, iconv, session
        id: php
setup.name: Provision PHP 8.3 (issue #54, visible setup step, no project install)

setup.raw:
- name: Remove the CI-only AppArmor launcher prerequisite
        if: always() && runner.os == 'Linux'
        timeout-minutes: 1
        run: |

          test "$(sysctl -n kernel.apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns)" = 1
          if sudo grep -Eq '^lekalo-ci-bwrap(-child)? ' /sys/kernel/security/apparmor/profiles; then
            exit 1
          fi
